title: Why pilgrim badges matter
body: Cheap, mass-produced badges like the one from Compostela are some of the best surviving evidence of ordinary pilgrim traffic — most pilgrims left no other written trace of their journey.

title: Shared roads, shared risks
body: Pilgrims often travelled the same roads as merchants and diplomatic couriers, sharing convoys, inns, and the same exposure to weather, tolls, and banditry.

title: Reading a merchant's ledger
body: Account books like the Lübeck ledger record shipments, but they also record the physical movement of the merchant's own agents between Baltic and North Sea ports.

title: Safe conduct and its limits
body: A letter of safe conduct was only as good as the political relationship behind it — a reminder of how fragile guarantees of safety were for travelling merchants.
